title: The Glassblower's Price Trick
story: Veldrase the Bargain Wraith haunts the glass market, whispering confusing prices until shoppers overpay and vanish into her fog. She offers Mr 6 three sky-globes at 4.75 ember coins each and two frost-vials at 6.40 ember coins each, then demands he hand over a purse of 40 ember coins. Mr 6 counts the change first — always the change first.
question: How many ember coins of change should Mr 6 get back from 40 after buying 3 sky-globes at 4.75 each and 2 frost-vials at 6.40 each?
hint: Work out the cost of the globes and the cost of the vials separately, add them, then subtract from 40.
victory: Mr 6 named his change down to the last hundredth of a coin, and Veldrase — who feeds only on confusion — thinned into harmless mist over the glassware.
imagePrompt: A pale swirling wraith of coins and fog behind a market stall of shimmering glass globes and vials at dusk, a small numeral six knight counting coins with a determined grin.
solution: Frost-vials cost 2 × 6.40 = 12.80, so the total is 14.25 + 12.80 = 27.05.
praise: Pricing each item group separately was a smart, organized way to start - the final step was subtracting the whole total from 40.
